notes.title: Deadly Tower 1.03 update
notes.notes:
- Fixed bug where teleportation screen was freezing in some systems. ***

- Fixed performance issue for systems using NvOptimus (which have Intel and Nvidia cards in the same computer).

- Added security system to avoid rare Boss Octopus non-progression.

- Some minor fixes to Russian localization.

*** Note: The teleportation freeze issue was apparently happening mostly on machines under the minimum specs, so we had to get our hands on new hardware to be able to reproduce and find the problem. The issue was resolved on our new test machine that was experiencing the reported issue.

notes.title: Deadly Tower 1.02 update
notes.notes: Very small update fixes sound ducking when subtitles are turned off. (Yesterday's patch allowed for turning subtitles off, but when the option was selected, the dialogue would not lower the game's volume properly. This was fixed now).

notes.title: Release details + new trailer!
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

With the addition of this new trailer we also wanted to update everyone with exciting news about the game's release on January 19th. 

The title will launch at [b]$14.99[/b] and during the first two weeks we will be offering a [b]33% discount[/b] for everyone who purchases during this period. In addition to the discount, we will also be giving away a bonus [b]Scarlet Nova digital calendar[/b] that we hope everyone enjoys. 

To wrap this update here's the next trailer where you can see many of the special skills the characters can utilize in the game. Hope you like it!

https://youtu.be/jgP0KXzf1oA
